about: Market facts go stale. Each entry quotes the market's own guidelines as they stood on date_checked; recheck the URL and update the wording and date before relying on an entry. `bars` lists what the AI-policy wording rules out: ai_writing (text written or generated by AI), ai_editing (AI editing or revising any of the text), ai_assistance (AI assistance of any kind), ai_any_point (AI use at any point in the process).

length.wording: We seldom buy stories shorter than 1,000 words or longer than 20,000 words, and we don’t serialize novels.

ai_policy.heading: Statement on the Use of “AI” writing tools such as ChatGPT
ai_policy.wording: We will not consider any submissions written, developed, or assisted by these tools. Attempting to submit these works may result in being banned from submitting works in the future.

length.wording: Analog pays 8-10 cents per word for short fiction (up to approximately 20,000 words)

ai_policy.heading: Statement on the Use of “AI” writing tools such as ChatGPT
ai_policy.wording: We will not consider any submissions written, developed, or assisted by these tools. Attempting to submit these works may result in being banned from submitting works in the future.

length.wording: Uncanny is looking for original, unpublished speculative fiction stories between 750-10,000 words

ai_policy.wording: Please note that Uncanny Magazine does not accept any submissions written with artificial intelligence or similar technologies. These submissions will be rejected, and authors will no longer be able to submit to Uncanny Magazine if they didn’t disclose that they used artificial intelligence or similar technologies for creating their submissions.

length.wording: Length: We strongly prefer under 15,000 words. We will consider stories over that length, but the longer a story is, the better it must be.

ai_policy.heading: Stories produced using “AI” (artificial intelligence)
ai_policy.wording: Spell check, basic grammar check, and AI-generated prompts that you then wrote your own story from are fine, but we are not interested in any story where AI apps or generators wrote or drafted or edited any portion of its text. … “AI”-based grammar check/editing: We are not interested in any story where AI apps edited any portion of its text, including AI-based grammar check.

length.wording: We are especially keen to read innovative and entertaining stories of between 2000 and 6000 words, but we have no set maximum length or minimum length and sometimes publish pieces which fall outside that range

ai_policy.wording: We do not use any form of AI or LLM in the production of Interzone and we don’t want to read stories that incorporate any amount of writing generated or revised by AI tools.
